assessments.reasoning: The section 7 passage at [9731,10296) in Eclipse's 1.0 plaintext identifies both the public copying permission and the exclusive authority to modify the Agreement. Reading both clauses preserves the claim's unchanged-copy condition.

challenge.method: Compared distributing the unchanged agreement on its own, replacing it with a translation or a substantively edited agreement, and distributing Program code alongside an unchanged agreement.
challenge.results: The first case fits. Both replacements change the agreement text and fall outside the unchanged-copy claim. In the software case, section 7 covers copying the agreement itself. Sections 2 and 3 separately govern rights in Contributions and distribution of the Program.

limitations: The Eclipse Foundation is the initial Agreement Steward and may assign that role. Section 7 reserves modification and publication of revised versions to the Steward.
